rootCauseAnalysis.trigger: The first adoption attempt failed before canonical mutation because validate_boundary passed the canonical backlog object to taskctl.index_backlog, which added private in-memory index metadata that the subsequent schema validation rejected.
rootCauseAnalysis.controlGap: The approved lifecycle represented successful P-to-A-to-F adoption but did not provide an append-only transition from an exact failed pre-activation A attempt back to REVIEW, and the single adoption-evidence path could not preserve the failed evidence while recording a later attempt.
rootCauseAnalysis.remediation: R03 validates indexes on a deep copy, authenticates the exact immutable failed pre-activation adoption before allowing resubmission, assigns R03 and later adoption evidence distinct attempt-scoped paths, and makes current and future readers accept only the path bound to the latest approved attempt.
rootCauseAnalysis.recurrencePrevention: Focused real-Git regressions now prove canonical successor validation is not contaminated by private index metadata and that failed adoption evidence remains immutable, direct-child bound, and non-reusable by later attempts.
